head: 2c7b635
issue: periodic multi-second input stalls / clicks delayed then frozen

rootCause.primary: shell.js setInterval(refreshStatus, 8000) invokes Tauri client_running; old Windows implementation spawned powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command Get-CimInstance Win32_Process synchronously via Command::output() on every refresh

measurementsBefore.consoleWindows: powershell child process created by GUI without CREATE_NO_WINDOW

secondary: all Windows background children (java/node/taskkill/powershell) spawned without CREATE_NO_WINDOW
save_window_geometry performed scale/outer_position/inner_size and settings lock/disk save on every Moved/Resized event before throttle

fix.clientRunning: Windows: EnumWindows finds visible Minecraft window; Linux: read /proc/*/cmdline; no process spawn
fix.noConsole: CommandExt::creation_flags(0x08000000) for Paper/engine/taskkill/prism cmd and run_capture
fix.geometry: throttle before window APIs; force save only on close

commands: UIAutomation InvokePattern on 设置/完成 toggles
conclusion: fixed for measured scenario; final NSIS rebuild/install pending
remaining: CSS zoom + WebView2 rendering performance still to profile under long textbook/Monaco use
add automated Windows perf smoke gate to prevent regression
